name: SMARDEX USDN
oneLiner: USDN is SMARDEX's wstETH-backed synthetic dollar, held near $1 by protocol long-side mechanics targeting delta-neutral exposure on a two-step oracle flow.
collateral: Synthetic dollar backed by the SMARDEX USDN vault, initially using wstETH as the underlying asset and protocol long-side mechanics to target delta-neutral exposure
pegMechanism: Users mint USDN by depositing supported underlying assets into the USDN vault and redeem by burning USDN for the corresponding underlying asset value. Mint and redemption flows can be temporarily restricted by protocol imbalance and use a two-step oracle validation flow.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Freeze-only re-review: the verified USDN token source has no confirmed address freeze or blacklist function, but privileged MINTER/REBASER roles plus protocol mint/redemption flow restrictions represent a direct mutable holder-facing control surface. This explicit Possible override also prevents false Upstream inheritance from the unrelated Noble USDN symbol.
